answer: A payout is split so that 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The zenith schedule is applied in kernel and pearl makes public each instalment. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2422 identities would post 1190 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
